purpose: Compile the next bounded rehydration task from observed cycle outputs without hiding the candidate set, policy, tie state, or deferred alternatives.
authority_ceiling: routing only; below evidence, admission, promotion, merge, release, and user authority
input_sources: current task continuation only for PARTIAL/HELD/NO_PROGRESS

metrics.law: routing metrics are planning heuristics, not truth/evidence/authority

selection.stage_2: score nondominated candidates with explicit policy weights

integration.ambiguous: compile a bounded ambiguity-resolution next task
integration.no_successor: compile a bounded remaining-objective reconstruction task
integration.persistence: baton is embedded in completion, therefore covered by the existing rehydration receipt/state/chain digest
